review_model.description: Review model override used by the `/review` feature.

model_provider.description: Provider to use from the model_providers map.

model_context_window.description: Size of the context window for the model, in tokens.

model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.

approval_policy.description: Default approval policy for executing commands.

notify.description: Optional external command to spawn for end-user notifications. Provide argv tokens; Codex appends a JSON payload describing each completed turn.

developer_instructions.description: Developer instructions inserted as a `developer` role message.

compact_prompt.description: Compact prompt used for history compaction.

forced_chatgpt_workspace_id.description: When set, restricts ChatGPT login to a specific workspace identifier.

forced_login_method.description: When set, restricts the login mechanism users may use.

cli_auth_credentials_store.description: Preferred backend for storing CLI auth credentials.

mcp_servers.description: Definition for MCP servers that Codex can reach out to for tool calls.

mcp_oauth_credentials_store.description: Preferred backend for storing MCP OAuth credentials.

model_providers.description: User-defined provider entries that extend/override the built-in list.

project_doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to include from an AGENTS.md project doc file.

project_doc_fallback_filenames.description: Ordered list of fallback filenames to look for when AGENTS.md is missing.

tool_output_token_limit.description: Token budget applied when storing tool/function outputs in the context manager.

profile.description: Profile to use from the `profiles` map.

profiles.description: Named profiles to facilitate switching between different configurations.

file_opener.description: Optional URI-based file opener. If set, citations to files in the model output will be hyperlinked using the specified URI scheme.

hide_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoning` events will be hidden from the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

show_raw_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoningRawContentEvent` events will be shown in the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

model_reasoning_effort.description: Value to use for `reasoning.effort` when making a request using the Responses API.

model_reasoning_summary.description: If not "none", the value to use for `reasoning.summary` when making a request using the Responses API.

model_verbosity.description: Optional verbosity control for GPT-5 models (Responses API `text.verbosity`).

model_supports_reasoning_summaries.description: Override to force-enable reasoning summaries for the configured model.

model_reasoning_summary_format.description: Override to force reasoning summary format for the configured model.

chatgpt_base_url.description: Base URL for requests to ChatGPT (as opposed to the OpenAI API).

projects.description: Project-specific trust settings keyed by project path.

check_for_update_on_startup.description: When `true`, checks for Codex updates on startup and surfaces update prompts. Set to `false` only if your Codex updates are centrally managed.

disable_paste_burst.description: When true, disables burst-paste detection for typed input entirely. All characters are inserted as they are received.

windows_wsl_setup_acknowledged.description: Tracks whether the Windows onboarding screen has been acknowledged.

experimental_use_unified_exec_tool.description: If set to `true`, used only the experimental unified exec tool.

experimental_use_rmcp_client.description: If set to `true`, use the experimental official Rust MCP client.

experimental_use_freeform_apply_patch.description: Include the freeform apply_patch tool (legacy toggle).

experimental_sandbox_command_assessment.description: When `true`, run a model-based assessment for commands denied by the sandbox.

oss_provider.description: Preferred OSS provider for local models, e.g. "lmstudio" or "ollama".

shell_environment_policy.description: Policy for building the `env` when spawning a process via either the `shell` or `local_shell` tool.

inherit.description: Starting point when building the environment.

ignore_default_excludes.description: True to skip filtering default excludes for env vars containing KEY or TOKEN.

exclude.description: List of regular expressions to exclude environment variables.

set.description: Environment variable key/value pairs to insert in the environment.

include_only.description: List of regular expressions; only matching environment variables are retained.

experimental_use_profile.description: If true, the shell profile will be used to run the command.

sandbox_workspace_write.description: Sandbox configuration to apply if `sandbox` is `WorkspaceWrite`.

writable_roots.description: Additional folders (beyond cwd and TMPDIR) that should be writable from within the sandbox.

network_access.description: When set to `true`, outbound network access is allowed.

exclude_tmpdir_env_var.description: When set to `true`, will NOT include the per-user `TMPDIR` environment variable among the default writable roots.

exclude_slash_tmp.description: When set to `true`, will NOT include `/tmp` among the default writable roots on UNIX.

history.description: Settings that govern if and what will be written to `~/.codex/history.jsonl`.

persistence.description: Save all history entries to disk or disable writing.

max_bytes.description: If set, the maximum size of the history file in bytes.

notifications.description: Enable desktop notifications from the TUI when the terminal is unfocused.

oneOf.description: Custom notification command argv to execute.

tui.description: Collection of settings that are specific to the TUI.

animations.description: Enable animations (welcome screen, shimmer effects, spinners).

notice.description: Collection of in-product notices (different from notifications).

hide_full_access_warning.description: Tracks whether the user has acknowledged the full access warning prompt.

hide_world_writable_warning.description: Tracks whether the user has acknowledged the Windows world-writable directories warning.

hide_rate_limit_model_nudge.description: Tracks whether the user opted out of the rate limit model switch reminder.

hide_gpt5_1_migration_prompt.description: Tracks whether the user has seen the model migration prompt.

hide_gpt-5.1-codex-max_migration_prompt.description: Tracks whether the user has seen the gpt-5.1-codex-max migration prompt.

client_private_key.description: Path to client private key file.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in OTLP/HTTP exporter.
Additional HTTP headers to include in OTLP/gRPC exporter.

environment.description: Mark traces with environment (dev, staging, prod, test). Defaults to dev.

mcp_server_config.description: Definition for an MCP server Codex can reach out to for tool calls.

enabled.description: When `false`, Codex skips initializing this MCP server.

startup_timeout_sec.description: Startup timeout in seconds for initializing MCP server & initially listing tools.

tool_timeout_sec.description: Default timeout for MCP tool calls initiated via this server.

enabled_tools.description: Explicit allow-list of tools exposed from this server.

disabled_tools.description: Explicit deny-list of tools removed after applying enabled_tools.

command.description: Stdio transport: command to launch MCP server.

args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP stdio server command.

env.description: Environment variables forwarded to the MCP stdio server.

env_vars.description: Environment variable names to forward to the MCP stdio server.

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP stdio server.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Name of environment variable providing HTTP bearer token.

http_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in requests to this server.

env_http_headers.description: HTTP headers whose values are sourced from environment variables.

trust_level.description: Trust level for the project directory.

config_profile.description: Collection of common configuration options that a user can define as a unit in `config.toml`.

model_provider.description: The key in the `model_providers` map identifying the model provider to use.

include_apply_patch_tool.description: Include the `apply_patch` tool for structured file edits.

tools_web_search.description: Allow the model to request web searches.

tools_view_image.description: Enable the `view_image` tool that lets the agent attach local images.

oss_provider.description: Preferred OSS provider for local models, e.g. "lmstudio" or "ollama".

tools.description: Nested tools section for feature toggles.

web_search.description: Allow the model to request web searches.

view_image.description: Enable the `view_image` tool that lets the agent attach local images.
